title: Closeout summary: Lock lifecycle: contention retry, single source of truth, decidable staleness
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented bounded search-index lock contention retry for refresh/rebuild, added shared runtime lock inspection for doctor and lock inspect, and made stale-lock detection use same-host owner PID plus heartbeat instead of only a fixed stale window.

Close reason: Acceptance criteria met; commit checkpoint recorded as dirty-path evidence because unrelated pre-existing staged and dirty changes prevent a scoped commit.
